counterexamples.finding: Fixed total environment interactions differs from per-update batch and fixed wallclock/gradient-update cost. Scaling batch changes update frequency;2–3day run description not equal-compute benchmark. Most mechanism plots8→16 also double batch, while8×128vs128×8 controls batch. Main PPO benefits do not prove universal data scaling or loss-function causal explanation of PPO-PQN difference.

Feature rank/dormant neurons/weight norms/log-gradient kurtosis are proxies not direct interventions proving plasticity. Policy variance is across-state action-probability dispersion, not temporal churn. Importance-weight ESS not temporal independence certificate; log-absolute-gradient kurtosis not raw-tail exponent. UMAP grid coverage depends fit/scaling/grid and sample count, not original state visitation probability. Keep these definitions locally, not repetitive disclaimers.

Gamma default0.99 inTable1 vs0.95Fig12; Figure16 onlyvariesNenvyetcaption comparesNRO; Figure14aggregate PQN visibly benefits more than weak-gain prose suggests. Figure4RiverraidESSblue lower thanblack despite universalhigher claim; feature rank Bowling countertrend inFig10. MetricB4calls sigma variance but uses fourth power; some minibatch/epoch/Isaac configs and UMAP shared-fit details absent. No sourcecode execution or independent significance testing.
